name: Press logo mark
notes: Four marks in DOM order on the homepage press bar, rendered at 24px tall.

LICENSING: these are four real third-party publications' trademarks. assetRole press.logo is pinned to must-not-reproduce-real-mark. A generated instance MUST NOT emit these files, copies of them, or imitations. The press-bar section's content contract therefore carries no logo-file field a generator can populate.
